blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Diffusion models are evolving from general tools into personalized systems that adapt to user needs through fine-tuning and guidance. However, diffusion optimization mainly targets measurable objectives such as aesthetics, rarely examining whether they align with human intent. Human needs are multidimensional, contextual, and dynamic, whereas existing methods approximate them with fixed metrics. Because these metrics capture human needs only partially and may amplify deviations from true intent during optimization, higher scores need not yield results better matching human expectations. To understand how human needs enter and influence optimization, we systematically analyze how human intent is expressed, translated into optimizable objectives, applied to model behavior or generation, and evaluated through outputs. We further discuss trade-offs affecting human-intent alignment in personalized image generation and gaps between automated metrics and real user judgments. This human-centered synthesis reorganizes diffusion optimization and provides a systematic reference for personalized generation systems designed for human preferences.
blocks.zh: 传播模式正在从一般工具演变成个性化系统,通过微调和指导适应用户需要. 然而,传播优化主要针对美学等可衡量的目标,很少审查这些目标是否与人类意图相符合. 人类需求是多层面的、内在的和动态的,而现有方法则与固定的衡量标准相近。 由于这些衡量标准只捕捉到人类的部分需要,并可能扩大在优化期间偏离真实意图的情况,因此,较高的分数不需要产生更符合人类期望的结果。 为了了解人类的需求是如何进入和影响优化的,我们系统地分析人类意图是如何表达的,如何转化为可选择的目标,如何应用到行为模型或生成模型,以及如何通过产出来评价。 我们进一步讨论了影响人与人之间个人形象生成一致性的取舍,以及自动化衡量尺度与实际用户判断之间的差距。 这种以人为中心的合成重组了传播优化,为为人取向设计的个性化生成系统提供了系统参考.

blocks.en: Figure 1. The framework illustrates how human intent originates from users and creators, researchers and developers, and domain experts; is represented and translated into machine-optimizable objectives; and subsequently influences diffusion model behavior through model-level and generation-level optimization. It further highlights the key trade-offs arising during optimization, including proxy fidelity, diversity–alignment balance, human agency, and system cost. Finally, it summarizes complementary evaluation practices, ranging from automated metrics to human-grounded evaluations, for assessing whether optimization outcomes genuinely align with evolving human intent..
blocks.zh: 图 1. 该框架说明人类意图如何源自用户和创造者、研究人员和开发者以及域专家;如何代表并转化为机器最佳目标;然后通过模型层面和生成层面优化影响传播模式行为。 它进一步突出了在优化过程中产生的关键权衡,包括代理忠诚、多样性-调整平衡、人力机构和系统成本。 最后,报告总结了从自动计量到以人为本的评价等各种补充评价做法,以评估优化成果是否真正符合不断变化的人类意图。

blocks.en: 1. Introduction
blocks.zh: 一、导 言 导言

blocks.en: Research on diffusion models ( Huang et al., 2024 ; Chen et al., 2024 ; Xiao et al., 2024 ; Choi et al., 2024 ; Son et al., 2024 ; Dhawka et al., 2024 ; Rajcic et al., 2024 ; Zhang et al., 2024a ; Lee et al., 2024 ; Kamali et al., 2025 ; Porquet et al., 2025 ) is shifting from “how to generate images” to “how to better meet specific human preferences” ( Wu et al., 2026b ; Liu et al., 2026a ) . In earlier text-to-image paradigms, users expressed intent mainly through prompts, and models generated images accordingly. Recently, fine-tuning ( Black et al., 2024 ) and training-free guidance ( Yan et al., 2026b ) have changed this interaction: generative models no longer merely respond to text prompts, but can adapt their behavior based on human preferences and feedback to optimize toward specific goals ( Black et al., 2023 ; Wallace et al., 2024a ) .
blocks.zh: 关于扩散模型的研究(黄等人, 2024年;Chen等人,2024年;Xiao等人,2024年;Choi等人,2024年;Son等人,2024年;Dhawka等人,2024年;Rajcic等人,2024年;Zhang等人,2024年a;Lee等人,2024年;Kamari等人,2025年;Porquet等人,2025年)正在从“如何生成图像”转向“如何更好地满足具体的人类喜好”(Wu等人,2026年b;Liu等人,2026年a年)。 在早期的文本到图像范式中,用户主要通过提示表达意向,模型也相应生成图像. 最近,微调(Black等人,2024年)和无培训指导(Yan等人,2026年b)改变了这种相互作用:基因模型不再仅仅响应文本提示,而是可以根据人类的偏好和反馈调整行为,优化到特定的目标(Black等人,2023年;Wallace等人,2024年a).

blocks.en: Despite these advances, optimizing generative models toward human preferences does not necessarily ensure that their outputs faithfully reflect human intent ( Dang et al., 2025 ) . Human needs are often multidimensional, subjective, and context-dependent, making it difficult to directly translate them into computational objectives and verify whether the resulting images truly satisfy user expectations ( Zhang et al., 2024c ) . Consequently, bridging the gap between human intent and personalized image generation involves three interconnected challenges.
blocks.zh: 尽管取得了这些进步,但优化人类偏好基因模型不一定能保证其产出忠实地反映人类的意图(Dang等人,2025年)。 人类的需求常常是多方面的,主观的,和上下文的依赖性的,因此很难直接将其转化为计算目标,并验证由此产生的图像是否真正满足了用户的期望(Zhang等人,2024c). 因此,弥合人类意图与个性化形象生成之间的差距涉及三个相互关联的挑战。

blocks.en: (1) User intent must be expressed and translated into computable objectives . User intent must first be externalized through text, choices, ratings, or other forms of feedback, and subsequently translated into machine-optimizable objectives ( Shen et al., 2026 ; Xu et al., 2023 ) . Thus, what optimization algorithms actually process is not human intent itself, but a proxy representation constructed from these interaction signals ( Zeng et al., 2024 ; Subramonyam et al., 2024 ) . Different forms of expression capture different aspects of user needs, and the same subjective need may be mapped to different computational objectives, potentially resulting in information loss before intent enters the optimization process ( Mahdavi Goloujeh et al., 2024 ; Fan et al., 2024 ) .
blocks.zh: (1) 用户意图必须表达并转化为可计算的目标。 用户意图必须首先通过文字,选择,评分或其他反馈形式进行外部化,然后转化为机器优化的目标(沈等人,2026年;徐等人,2023年). 因此,优化算法实际处理的不是人类意图本身,而是从这些相互作用信号中构建的代理代表(Zeng等人,2024年;Subramonyam等人,2024年). 不同表达形式捕捉用户需求的不同方面,同样的主观需求可能会被映射到不同的计算目标上,在意向进入优化过程之前可能造成信息损失(Mahdavi Goloujeh等人,2024年;Fan等人,2024年).

blocks.en: (2) Different user needs must be coordinated as optimization objectives . Personalized generation often involves multiple dimensions, such as aesthetic quality, semantic consistency, realism, and diversity ( Zhang et al., 2024c ; Fan et al., 2024 ) . These dimensions may naturally compete with each other, and their importance can change across tasks and generated results ( Zhou et al., 2024 ; Maier et al., 2026 ) . However, existing methods usually combine multiple evaluation objectives in a static way, compressing users’ multidimensional and dynamic needs into optimization signals with fixed weights ( Lee et al., 2025 ; Lee and Choi, 2026 ) . Such preset objective relations are hard to adjust with changing user preferences ( Cheng et al., 2026 ) . As a result, the model may keep reinforcing some objectives while sacrificing others that are more important in the current context, causing the optimization direction to deviate from users’ actual preferences ( Jena et al., 2024 ; Hong et al., 2026b ; Amershi et al., 2019 ) .
blocks.zh: (2) 不同的用户需求必须作为优化目标加以协调。 个性化一代往往涉及多个维度,如美学质量,语义一致性,现实主义,以及多样性(张等,2024c;范等,2024). 这些维度可能自然地相互竞争,它们的重要性会因任务而异,并产生结果(周等人,2024年;迈耶等人,2026年). 然而,现有方法通常以静态的方式将多个评价目标结合起来,将用户的多维和动态需求压缩为具有固定权重的优化信号(Lee等人,2025年;Lee和Choi,2026年). 这种预先设定的客观关系很难随着用户偏好的变化而调整(Cheng等人,2026年). 因此,该模式可能会继续强化一些目标,同时牺牲其他在当前背景下更为重要的目标,导致优化方向偏离用户的实际偏好(Jena等人,2024年;Hong等人,2026年b;Amershi等人,2019年).

blocks.en: (3) Optimization outcomes must be validated against actual human preferences . Improving predefined optimization objectives does not necessarily mean that generated results better satisfy human needs or align with user intent ( Wadinambiarachchi et al., 2024 ; Jayasumana et al., 2024 ) . Existing studies often evaluate generated outputs using reward scores, text-image alignment, aesthetic metrics, or other automated evaluators, which may share similar assumptions with the objectives used during optimization ( Wiles et al., 2025 ; Li et al., 2024a ) . Consequently, even when both optimization targets and evaluation metrics improve, it remains unclear whether these improvements correspond to what users actually perceive, prefer, or expect from the generated results ( Ma et al., 2025 ; Naqvi et al., 2025 ) . From a human-centered perspective, evaluating personalized generation requires moving beyond automated metrics to consider human judgments, individual preferences, and the specific contexts in which users interact with generative systems ( Wang et al., 2024a ; Wang et al., 2024b ) . For highly subjective and context-dependent needs, the key is therefore not merely to confirm improvements in proxy metrics, but to examine whether these gains translate into greater satisfaction of human preferences and better alignment with users’ actual intentions ( Cao et al., 2025b ) .
blocks.zh: (3) 优化结果必须对照人类的实际偏好加以验证。 改进预先界定的优化目标并不一定意味着产生的结果能更好地满足人类需要或符合用户的意图(Wadinambiarachchi等人,2024年;Jayasumana等人,2024年)。 现有研究经常使用奖励分数,文本图像对齐,审美度量,或其他自动评价员来评价产生的产出,这些评价员可能与优化期间使用的目标有相似的假设(Wiles等人,2025年;Li等人,2024年a). 因此,即使优化目标和评价指标都有所改善,这些改进是否与用户实际所感知、偏好或对所产生结果的期望相符仍然不清楚(Ma等人,2025年;Naqvi等人,2025年)。 从以人为本的角度来看,评估个性化生成需要超越自动的衡量标准,以考虑人的判断、个人偏好以及用户与基因系统互动的具体环境(Wang等人,2024a); Wang et al., 2024b ) (中文(中国大陆) ). 因此,对于高度主观和依赖背景的需求而言,关键不仅仅是要确认代理计量的改进,而是要审查这些收益是否转化为对人类喜好的更满意和更好地与用户的实际意图保持一致(Cao等人,2025年b)。

blocks.en: Together, these three challenges highlight that human intent is not directly mapped to the final output of a generative system; instead, it undergoes a continuous transformation process. Human intent must be represented as machine-optimizable objectives, which are then coordinated and translated into changes in model behavior or generation trajectories ( Fu et al., 2025 ; Shen et al., 2025 ) . Throughout this process, incomplete proxy representations, competing objectives, and optimization mechanisms may introduce tensions and unintended outcomes, potentially weakening alignment with human preferences. Ultimately, whether optimization truly succeeds must be assessed through human-centered validation rather than improvements in automated metrics alone ( Huh et al., 2025 ; Trinh et al., 2025 ) . These interconnected challenges suggest that understanding human-centered diffusion model optimization requires examining not only how optimization is performed, but also how human intent is represented, transformed, potentially distorted, and ultimately evaluated. Therefore, rather than organizing existing studies by algorithm type ( Jiang et al., 2024b ; Cao et al., 2025a ) . This paper re-examines diffusion model optimization through four interconnected dimensions: intent representation, optimization mechanisms, failure modes and trade-offs, and human-centered validation. Based on this perspective, we address the following four research questions:
blocks.zh: 这三个挑战共同突出表明,人类的意图并没有直接被描绘为一个基因系统的最后产出;相反,它经历了一个持续的转变过程。 人类的本意必须表现为机器上最理想的目标,然后加以协调,转化为模型行为或生成轨迹的变化(Fu等人,2025年;Shen等人,2025年)。 在整个过程中,不完整的代理表述、相互竞争的目标和优化机制可能带来紧张和意外结果,有可能削弱与人类偏好的一致性。 归根结底,是否真正成功的优化必须通过以人为本的验证来评估,而不是仅仅通过改进自动化衡量标准来评估(Huh等人,2025年;Trinh等人,2025年)。 这些相互关联的挑战表明,理解以人为本的传播模式优化不仅需要审查如何实现优化,而且需要审查人类意图如何体现、转变、潜在扭曲和最终评估。 因此,与其按算法类型组织现有研究(Jiang等人,2024b;Cao等人,2025a). 本文通过四个互联互通的维度重新审查传播模型优化:意向表示,优化机制,失败模式和权衡,以及以人为本的验证. 根据这一观点,我们处理以下四个研究问题:

blocks.en: • RQ1: How is human intent represented and operationalized in diffusion model optimization? • RQ2: How do existing optimization paradigms translate human intent into changes in model behavior or generation trajectories? • RQ3: What tensions and failure modes emerge when optimizing diffusion models toward human-defined or human-proxied objectives? • RQ4: How is alignment with human intent validated through automated and human-centered evaluations, and what limitations remain in current evaluation practices?

blocks.en: To address these research questions, we systematically review existing studies on diffusion model optimization through a human-centered analytical framework encompassing four interconnected dimensions: intent representation, optimization mechanisms, failure modes and trade-offs, and human-centered validation. Specifically, we investigate how human intent is expressed and translated into machine-optimizable objectives (RQ1), how different optimization paradigms translate these objectives into changes in model behavior or generation trajectories (RQ2), what tensions and failure modes emerge during optimization (RQ3), and how existing evaluation practices assess whether optimization outcomes genuinely align with human preferences and user needs (RQ4). By connecting these dimensions, our review provides a unified perspective on how human intent is represented, operationalized, executed, and validated throughout diffusion model optimization. The main contributions of this paper are as follows: • We systematically examine how human intent is expressed, represented, and translated into machine-optimizable objectives, revealing potential information loss and mismatches between user needs and computational proxies. • We organize reinforcement-learning fine-tuning and inference-time optimization into model-level and generation-level paradigms, systematically comparing how they translate human-centered objectives into changes in model behavior or generation trajectories. • We identify key trade-offs and failure modes in human-centered diffusion model optimization, examining how proxy-objective mismatch, competing objectives, reduced diversity, and optimization costs may undermine alignment with human intent. • We systematically examine automated and human-centered evaluation practices, highlighting discrepancies between proxy-based metrics and actual human judgments, and identifying limitations in validating whether optimization outcomes genuinely satisfy user needs. The overall structure of this survey and the logical relationships among its sections are summarized in Fig . 2 .
blocks.zh: 为了解决这些研究问题,我们通过一个以人为本的分析框架,系统地审查关于传播模型优化的现有研究,该框架包括四个相互关联的方面:意图表达、优化机制、失败模式和权衡以及以人为本的验证。 具体而言,我们调查人类意图如何表达并转化为机器最佳目标(RQ1),不同的优化范式如何将这些目标转化为模式行为或生成轨迹的变化(RQ2),在优化过程中会出现何种紧张和失败模式(RQ3),以及现有评价做法如何评估优化结果是否真正符合人类喜好和用户需求(RQ4). 通过将这些层面联系起来,我们的审查提供了一个统一的观点,说明在整个传播模式优化过程中,人类的意图是如何体现、操作、执行和验证的。 本文件的主要贡献如下: 我们系统地审查人类意图的表达、表达和转化为机器最佳目标的方式,揭示潜在的信息损失以及用户需求和计算代理人之间的不匹配。 我们组织强化学习微调和推论时间优化为模型层次和生成层次范式,系统比较它们如何将以人为本的目标转化为模型行为或生成轨迹的变化. ^ 我们确定以人为中心的传播模式优化中的关键权衡和失败模式,审查代理-客观不匹配、目标相互竞争、多样性减少和优化成本如何会破坏与人类意图的一致。 我们系统地审查自动化和以人为本的评价做法,强调基于代理的衡量标准与实际人力判断之间的差异,并查明在核实优化结果是否真正满足用户需求方面存在的局限性。 本调查的总体结构及其各节之间的逻辑关系摘要见图。 2 (英语).

blocks.zh: 2. 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1. Human Intent in Diffusion Model Optimization
blocks.zh: 2.1. 人为扩散模型优化

blocks.en:
Diffusion models ( Smith et al., 2026 ; Zhao et al., 2026 ; Grace et al., 2026 ; Li et al., 2026b ; Simonen et al., 2026 ; Wang et al., 2023 ; Moore et al., 2023 ; Yan et al., 2026e ) generate images through iterative denoising, allowing external signals to influence intermediate states and offering more control than one-shot conditioning. Early classifier and classifier-free guidance show that changing sampling directions can shape outputs and trade off quality, alignment, and diversity.
Recently, such control has moved toward preference-driven personalized generation. Some methods update model parameters to change long-term behavior ( Zhao et al., 2022 ; Gan et al., 2024 ; Yan et al., 2026d ; Yan et al., 2026c ) , while others keep parameters fixed and adjust latents or denoising trajectories at inference time. We call them model-level optimization and generation-level optimization .
From an HCI view, the key is not only what reward is used, but how human needs enter the system ( Yan et al., 2026f ) . In generative AI, user goals are often clarified through repeated generation, observation, and revision ( Amershi et al., 2019 ; Brade et al., 2023 ; Wang et al., 2024b ) . Prompts are only one expression form and are limited for fine-grained or contextual needs; choices, clicks, and context can further convey intent ( Shen et al., 2026 ; Fan et al., 2024 ) . Thus, human intent refers to the user’s overall goal for both the desired output and the generation process, while interaction signals are its external representations ( Brade et al., 2023 ) .
We define human-centered diffusion model optimization as obtaining goals related to human needs and using them to actively change model behavior or generation trajectories. These needs may come directly from users or through proxy models ( Xu et al., 2023 ; Black et al., 2023 ; Prabhudesai et al., 2023 ; Bansal et al., 2024 ; Yan et al., 2026a ) .
blocks.zh:
传播模式 (Smith等人,2026年;Zhao等人,2026年;Grace等人,2026年;Li等人,2026年b;Simonen等人,2026年;Wang等人,2023年;Moore等人,2023年;Yan等人,2026年e)通过迭代去诺来生成图像,允许外部信号影响中间状态,提供比一弹配置更多的控制. 早期的分类器和无分类器的指引显示,改变采样方向可以塑造输出,并交换质量,对齐,多样性.
最近,这种控制已转向以优惠为驱动的个性化一代。 一些方法更新模型参数以改变长期行为(Zhao等人,2022年;Gan等人,2024年;Yan等人,2025年). 2026d; Yan et al., 2026c ),而其他人则在推论时间保留参数固定并调整潜伏或去诺定轨. 我们称之为模型级优化和生成级优化。
从HCI的观点来看,关键不仅在于使用什么奖励,而且在于人类的需求是如何进入系统的(Yan等人,2026f.). 在基因AI中,用户目标经常通过反复生成,观察,以及修订来澄清(Amershi等人,2019年;Brade等人,2023年;Wang等人,2024年b). 提示只是一种表达形式,因细腻或上下文的需要而受到限制;选择,点击,上下文可以进一步传达意向(沈等人,2026年;范等人,2024年). 因此,人类意图是指用户对预期输出和生成过程的总体目标,而互动信号则是其外部表达(Brade等人,2023年).
我们把以人为本的传播模型优化定义为获得与人类需求相关的目标,并用它们来积极改变模型行为或生成轨迹. 这些需求可能直接来自用户或通过代理模型(徐等人,2023年;布莱克等人,2023年;普拉布德斯泰等人,2023年;班萨尔等人,2024年;颜等人,2026年a).

blocks.en: 2.2. Human-Centered Diffusion Model Optimization
blocks.zh: 2.2. 以人为本的传播模式优化

blocks.en: Diffusion model optimization has evolved from improving generation capabilities and controllability toward aligning generated outputs with human preferences and intentions. Early research primarily focused on the fundamental principles and generation capabilities of text-to-image diffusion models ( Zhang et al., 2023 ) . Subsequent studies extended these capabilities through controllable generation, introducing different mechanisms for incorporating specific conditions, multiple constraints, and general control signals into the generation process ( Jiang et al., 2024b ; Cao et al., 2025a ) . While these advances have improved the controllability of diffusion models, they primarily address how generation can be technically controlled rather than whether the resulting outputs genuinely satisfy human needs.
blocks.zh: 传播模式优化已经从提高发电能力和可控性发展到使产生的产出与人类的喜好和意图相一致。 早期的研究主要集中于文本到图像传播模型的基本原则和生成能力(张等,2023). 随后的研究通过可控生成方式扩展了这些能力,引入了不同的机制,将特定条件,多种制约,以及一般控制信号纳入生成过程(Jiang等人,2024b;Cao等人,2025a). 虽然这些进展改善了传播模型的可控性,但它们主要涉及如何从技术上控制生成,而不是由此产生的产出是否真正满足人类需求。

blocks.en: More recently, diffusion model optimization has increasingly incorporated human preferences and feedback into the generation process. Research has explored preference modeling, reinforcement learning from human feedback (RLHF), direct preference optimization (DPO), and test-time alignment to steer generative models toward human-defined objectives ( Liu et al., 2026a ) . Related studies have examined preference alignment in image generation and editing, highlighting the roles of reward modeling, RLHF, and DPO in adapting generation behavior to human preferences ( Wu et al., 2026b ) . These developments suggest a growing shift from optimizing predefined technical objectives toward incorporating human preferences into model optimization. However, human preferences are often represented through computational proxies, raising questions about whether improvements in these objectives genuinely reflect users’ underlying intentions.
blocks.zh: 最近,推广模式的优化日益将人类的喜好和反馈纳入生成过程。 研究探索了偏好模型,从人类反馈(RLHF)中强化学习,直接偏好优化(DPO),以及试验时间对接,引导基因模型向人类定义的目标方向发展(Liu等人,2026a). 相关研究审查了图像生成和编辑中的偏好调整,强调了奖励建模、RLHF和DPO在使生成行为适应人类偏好方面的作用(Wu等人,2026b)。 这些发展动态表明,从优化预先确定的技术目标向将人类偏好纳入模式优化的转变正在增加。 然而,人类的偏好往往通过计算代理人来体现,这使人们怀疑这些目标的改善是否真正反映了用户的基本意图。

blocks.en: From a human-centered computing perspective, effective optimization requires not only improving predefined objectives but also understanding how human intent is expressed, interpreted, and incorporated into generative systems. Prior HCI research emphasizes that user goals are not necessarily fixed or fully specified in advance; instead, they may be progressively clarified and revised through interaction, feedback, and contextual information ( Amershi et al., 2019 ; Shen et al., 2026 ; Fan et al., 2024 ) . Accordingly, human-centered diffusion model optimization should be understood as a process that connects human intent with computational objectives, uses these objectives to influence model behavior or generation trajectories, and evaluates whether the resulting outputs genuinely satisfy user needs. This perspective moves beyond classifying optimization techniques solely by their technical mechanisms and instead emphasizes how human intent is represented, operationalized, and maintained throughout the optimization process.
blocks.zh: 从以人为本的计算角度看,有效的优化不仅需要改进预先确定的目标,还需要了解人类的意图是如何表达、解释和融入基因系统。 此前的HCI研究强调,用户目标不一定事先固定或完全指明;相反,可以通过互动,反馈,以及背景信息逐步澄清和修订(Amershi等人,2019年;沈等人,2026年;范等人,2024年). 因此,以人为本的传播模型优化应理解为将人类意图与计算目标联系起来的过程,利用这些目标影响模型行为或生成轨迹,并评价由此产生的输出是否真正满足用户需求. 这一视角超越了仅根据其技术机制对优化技术进行分类,而是强调在整个优化过程中如何体现、操作和维持人类意图。

blocks.en: 2.3. Human-Centered Evaluation of Generative AI
blocks.zh: 2.3. 对基因AI的以人为本的评价

blocks.en: Evaluating generative AI has traditionally relied on automated metrics to assess the quality of generated outputs. In image generation, commonly used measures include visual fidelity, text-image alignment, aesthetic quality, and learned preference scores. These metrics provide scalable and efficient evaluation mechanisms, but their improvements do not necessarily correspond to human perceptions or preferences. Prior research has identified discrepancies between automated metrics and human judgments, highlighting the importance of incorporating human evaluation when assessing text-to-image generation ( Otani et al., 2023 ; Wiles et al., 2025 ) . From a human-centered perspective, evaluation should therefore consider not only measurable output quality but also whether generated results satisfy users’ actual expectations.
blocks.zh: 评估遗传性人工智能传统上依靠自动计量来评估生成产出的质量。 在图像生成中,常用的度量包括视觉忠贞,文本图像对齐,美学质量,以及学到的偏好分数. 这些衡量标准提供了可扩展和有效的评价机制,但其改进不一定符合人类的观念或偏好。 先前的研究已经查明了自动计量法与人类判断之间的差异,突出了在评估文字到图像生成时纳入人类评价的重要性(Otani等人,2023年;Wiles等人,2025年)。 因此,从以人为本的角度来看,评价不仅应考虑可衡量的产出质量,而且应考虑所产生的结果是否满足用户的实际期望。

blocks.en: HCI research has demonstrated that evaluating generative systems requires attention to preferences and interaction contexts. For example, PromptCharm investigates how multimodal prompting and iterative refinement help users generate images that better match their intentions ( Wang et al., 2024b ) . Similarly, RoomDreaming examines personalized design exploration by considering users’ preferences, interaction efficiency, and satisfaction throughout the creative process ( Wang et al., 2024a ) . Collaborative fashion-design systems provide HCI examples of generative AI embedded in multi-stage creative workflows. CrossGAI supports cross-device designer collaboration through AI-assisted sketch retrieval, sketch generation, and sketch-to-image synthesis, whereas HAIGEN integrates text-guided inspiration, personalized sketch-material retrieval, sketch refinement, and coloring ( Deng et al., 2024 ; Jiang et al., 2024a ) . Other studies have shown that AI-generated content can influence users’ creative exploration and decision-making, suggesting that improvements in generation capabilities do not necessarily lead to better interaction experiences ( Wadinambiarachchi et al., 2024 ) . These findings indicate that human-centered evaluation extends beyond assessing generated outputs to understanding how users interact with, interpret, and refine generative results.
blocks.zh: HCI的研究表明,评价基因系统需要关注偏好和互动背景. 例如,PowerCharm调查了多式联运如何促进和迭代完善,帮助用户生成更加符合其意图的图像(Wang等人,2024b )。 同样,RoomDreaming通过在整个创作过程中考虑用户的偏好、互动效率和满意程度,审查个性化设计探索(Wang等人,2024a) 。 。 。 协作时装设计系统提供了嵌入多阶段创意工作流程的基因AI的HCI实例. 交叉 GAI通过AI辅助素描检索,素描生成,以及素描到图像合成,支持跨设备设计师协作,而HAIGEN则整合了文字指导灵感,个性化素描-素描检索,素描精炼,以及配色(Deng等人,2024年;Jiang等人,2024年a). 其他研究表明AI生成的内容可以影响用户的创造性探索和决策,这表明生成能力的提高并不一定导致更好的互动经验(Wadinambiarachchi等人,2024年). 这些结果表明,以人为中心的评价超越了对产出的评估,而扩大到了了解用户如何与遗传性结果互动、解释和完善。

blocks.en: Meanwhile, the reliability of human evaluation remains a consideration. Human judgments may vary with evaluation criteria, participant backgrounds, and experimental protocols, making evaluation design and reproducibility essential ( Otani et al., 2023 ) . Accordingly, human-centered evaluation requires combining automated measurements with human judgments and contextual assessments to determine whether generative systems support user needs. This perspective provides an important foundation for examining how human-intent alignment is evaluated in diffusion model optimization.
blocks.zh: 同时,人类评价的可靠性仍然是一个考虑因素。 人类判断可能因评价标准、参与者背景和实验协议而异,使得评价设计和可复制性至关重要(Otani等人,2023年)。 因此,以人为中心的评价需要将自动计量与人类判断和背景评估相结合,以确定基因系统是否支持用户需求。 这一视角为审查如何在传播模式优化中评价人与人之间的结合提供了重要基础。

blocks.en: 2.4. Existing Surveys and Our Perspective
blocks.zh: 2.4. 现有调查和我们的观点

blocks.en: Existing surveys have examined diffusion models from several complementary perspectives. Early reviews primarily focused on the foundations, architectures, and generation capabilities of text-to-image diffusion models ( Zhang et al., 2023 ) . Subsequent surveys extended this scope to controllable generation, systematically organizing existing methods according to control conditions, implementation mechanisms, and evaluation strategies ( Jiang et al., 2024b ; Cao et al., 2025a ) . More recently, research on diffusion model alignment has received increasing attention. Liu et al. ( Liu et al., 2026a ) reviewed alignment objectives, preference modeling, optimization techniques, and evaluation benchmarks, while Wu et al. ( Wu et al., 2026b ) provided a comprehensive analysis of preference alignment in image generation and editing, covering reinforcement learning from human feedback, direct preference optimization, and reward modeling. Together, these surveys establish an important foundation for understanding the technical development of diffusion models and their alignment with human preferences.
blocks.zh: 现有的调查从几个互补的角度审查了传播模式。 早期评论主要关注文本到图像传播模型的基础,架构,和生成能力(张等,2023). 随后的调查将这一范围扩大到可控制发电,根据控制条件、执行机制和评价战略系统地组织现有方法(Jiang等人,2024b;Cao等人,2025a)。 最近,关于传播模式调整的研究受到越来越多的关注。 刘等. (Liu et al.,2026a)审查了配对目标,偏好模型,优化技术,以及评价基准,而Wu et al. (Wu et al., 2026b)全面分析了图像生成和编辑中的偏好调整,涵盖从人类反馈中学习强化,直接偏好优化,以及奖励模式. 这些调查共同为了解传播模式的技术发展及其与人类偏好的一致性奠定了重要基础。

blocks.en: Despite their complementary contributions, these reviews differ from our work in their primary analytical focus. Existing surveys generally emphasize model capabilities, control mechanisms, optimization paradigms, or alignment techniques, whereas the transformation of human intent across different stages of optimization receives less integrated treatment. In particular, how user needs are expressed through interaction, translated into computational proxies, coordinated as optimization objectives, and subsequently validated against actual human preferences is not typically examined as a unified process. This distinction is important because successful optimization of a predefined objective does not necessarily imply that the resulting generation faithfully reflects the user’s underlying intent, especially when preferences are subjective, multidimensional, and context-dependent.
blocks.zh: 尽管这些审查具有互补性,但它们的主要分析重点与我们的工作不同。 现有的调查一般强调模型能力,控制机制,优化范式,或对齐技术,而不同优化阶段的人类意向转变则得到的集成处理较少. 特别是如何通过互动表达用户需求,转换为计算代词,协调为优化目标,随后对照实际人类偏好进行验证,一般不作为一个统一的过程来审查. 这种区分很重要,因为成功优化预先确定的目标并不一定意味着由此产生的一代忠实地反映了用户的基本意图,特别是在偏好主观、多层面和取决于背景的情况下。

blocks.en:
To complement existing surveys, our work adopts human intent transformation as its central analytical perspective. Rather than introducing another taxonomy based primarily on model architectures or optimization algorithms, we connect four interconnected dimensions: intent representation, optimization mechanisms, failure modes and trade-offs, and human-centered validation. This perspective enables us to examine how human needs enter diffusion model optimization, how computational objectives influence model behavior or generation trajectories, where deviations from human intent may emerge, and whether optimization outcomes are genuinely supported by human judgments. By integrating these dimensions into a unified analytical framework, our review provides a human-centered understanding of diffusion model optimization that complements existing technical and preference-alignment surveys. Tab . 2 compares representative surveys on diffusion models, controllable generation, and preference alignment with our human-centered perspective.
Unlike prior surveys primarily organized around generation capabilities, control mechanisms, or alignment techniques, our review examines how human intent is represented, transformed into computational objectives, executed through optimization, potentially distorted, and ultimately validated against actual human needs.
blocks.zh:
为了补充现有的调查,我们的工作将人的意志转变作为其核心分析视角。 我们没有引入另一个主要基于模型架构或优化算法的分类学,而是连接了四个相互关联的维度:意图表达,优化机制,失败模式和权衡,以及以人为本的验证. 这一视角使我们能够研究人类需求如何进入传播模型优化,计算目标如何影响模型行为或生成轨迹,哪里会出现偏离人类意图的情况,以及优化结果是否得到人类判断的真正支持. 通过将这些方面纳入一个统一的分析框架,我们的审查提供了对传播模式优化的一种以人为本的理解,补充了现有的技术和偏好调整调查。 Tab . 2 比较关于传播模型、可控生成和偏好与我们以人为本的观点的有代表性的调查。
与以前主要围绕发电能力、控制机制或对齐技术组织的调查不同,我们的审查审查人类意图是如何体现的,如何转化为计算目标,如何通过优化、潜在扭曲和最终根据人类的实际需要加以验证。

blocks.en: 3. Review Methodology
blocks.zh: 3个 审查方法

blocks.en: To systematically examine how human intent enters and shapes diffusion model optimization, we conduct a systematic literature review guided by the four research questions. Our methodology consists of three stages: First , we identify and screen relevant studies through cross-database searches, citation tracking, and predefined selection criteria; Second , we extract technical and human-centered information from the selected studies and conduct iterative thematic analysis; Finally , we organize the resulting evidence around four interconnected dimensions: intent representation, optimization mechanisms, failure modes and trade-offs, and human-centered validation. An overview of the systematic review workflow, including study identification, thematic analysis, and the final analytical scope, is presented in Fig . 3 .
blocks.zh: 为了系统地审查人类意图如何进入并塑造传播模式优化,我们以四个研究问题为指导,进行系统的文献审查。 我们的方法包括三个阶段:第一,我们通过跨数据库搜索、引用跟踪和预先确定的选择标准确定和筛选相关研究;第二,我们从选定的研究中提取技术和以人为本的信息,并进行迭代专题分析;最后,我们围绕四个相互关联的方面组织由此产生的证据:意图表达、优化机制、失败模式和权衡以及以人为本的验证。 图中概述了系统审查工作流程,包括研究确定、专题分析和最后分析范围。 页:1

blocks.en: 3.1. Search and Study Selection
blocks.zh: 3.1. 搜索和学习选择

blocks.en: We searched studies published between January 2020 and September 2026 on diffusion model optimization, human preferences, and human–AI interaction. The databases included ACM Digital Library, IEEE Xplore, Web of Science, Scopus, and arXiv, covering HCI, computer vision, machine learning, and generative AI.
blocks.zh: 我们搜索了2020年1月至2026年9月期间发表的关于传播模型优化、人类偏好和人类-AI互动的研究。 数据库包括ACM数字图书馆,IEEE Xplore,Web of Science,Scopus,和arXiv,涵盖HCI,计算机视觉,机器学习,和基因AI.

blocks.en:
The search strategy was organized around three concept groups, as summarized in Tab. 3 .
The search terms were organized into three concept groups. The first focused on diffusion models, including diffusion model , text-to-image diffusion , and diffusion-based image generation . The second identified optimization mechanisms, including reinforcement learning , RLHF , preference optimization , DPO , reward optimization , training-free guidance , inference/test-time optimization , latent optimization , and trajectory optimization . The third focused on human intent and interaction, including human preference , human feedback , human intent , user preference , alignment , personalization , human-centered , user interaction , interactive generation , iterative refinement , and human-AI co-creation . Since different research communities describe human-centered optimization using different terminology, we did not require studies to explicitly mention human intent or human-centered . Instead, we examined whether their optimization objectives could be meaningfully connected to human needs, preferences, or interaction signals during full-text screening.
blocks.zh:
搜索战略是围绕三个概念组组织的,Tab对此作了概述。 页:1
搜索术语分为三个概念组。 第一个侧重于传播模型,包括传播模型、文字到图像传播和基于传播的图像生成。 第二项确定优化机制,包括强化学习、RLHF、偏好优化、DPO、奖励优化、无培训指导、推断/测试时间优化、潜在优化和轨迹优化。 第三个关注人类意图与互动,包括人类偏好,人类反馈,人类意图,用户偏好,对齐,个性化,以人为本,用户互动,交互生成,迭代完善,以及人类-AI共创. 由于不同的研究团体使用不同的术语来描述以人为本的优化,我们并不要求研究明确提及人类意图或以人为本。 相反,我们审查了在全文筛选过程中,其优化目标是否可以与人类需求、偏好或互动信号有意义地联系起来。

blocks.en: To reduce omissions caused by keyword variation, we further conducted forward and backward citation tracking on representative studies of reinforcement-learning fine-tuning, preference optimization, training-free guidance, and diffusion alignment, and examined references in related surveys. All studies identified through citation tracking were screened using the same criteria as database results.
blocks.zh: 为减少关键词变化造成的遗漏,我们进一步对关于强化学习微调、优化偏好、无培训指导和传播调整等代表性研究进行了前后引用跟踪,并审查了相关调查中的引用。 通过引用跟踪确定的所有研究都采用了与数据库结果相同的标准。

blocks.en: The selection process included deduplication, title–abstract screening, and full-text assessment. We excluded surveys, opinion articles, tutorials, posters, theses, and short papers without complete method descriptions from the core research corpus; relevant surveys were retained for background analysis and citation tracking. During full-text screening, studies were assessed according to our definition of human-centered diffusion model optimization . Included studies had to satisfy two criteria. First, diffusion models had to serve as the primary generation mechanism, with the proposed method modifying model parameters or the generation process. Second, the optimization objectives had to be directly or indirectly connected to human needs, preferences, or evaluations. Such connections could be established through explicit user feedback, ratings, rankings, pairwise preferences, or computational proxies, including reward and preference models trained on human evaluation data ( Zhong et al., 2025 ) . Importantly, these different forms of human involvement were not treated as equivalent, since computational proxies may capture only selected aspects of the original human intent.
blocks.zh: 甄选过程包括脱钩、标题-摘要筛选和全文评估。 我们把调查、意见文章、辅导、海报、论文和没有完整方法说明的短篇论文排除在核心研究资料库之外;保留了相关的调查,用于背景分析和引用跟踪。 在全文筛选期间,根据我们对以人为本的传播模型优化的定义对研究进行了评估。 包括的研究必须符合两项标准。 首先,传播模型必须作为主要生成机制,由拟议方法修改模型参数或生成过程。 第二,优化目标必须与人类需求、偏好或评价直接或间接相关。 可以通过明确的用户反馈、评级、排名、对等偏好或计算代用,包括就人类评价数据培训的奖励和偏好模式,建立这种联系(Zhong等人,2025年)。 重要的是,这些不同形式的人类参与不被视为等同的,因为计算代理人可能只捕捉人类原始意图中的某些方面.

blocks.en: Accordingly, we excluded studies focused solely on pretraining, model compression, sampling acceleration, distillation, memory efficiency, or numerical solver efficiency. General conditional or controllable generation was not included simply because it employed textual, positional, or structural conditions, unless these signals further participated in preference-driven optimization. Studies focusing on human–AI interaction, user experience, intent expression, or evaluation without directly optimizing diffusion models were retained as contextual references rather than included in the core corpus. Similarly, works proposing reward models, evaluation metrics, or benchmarks without optimizing diffusion models were used as supplementary evidence for analyzing human-centered evaluation practices.
blocks.zh: 因此,我们排除了仅侧重于前训练、模型压缩、取样加速、蒸馏、内存效率或数字解析效率的研究。 除非这些信号进一步参与偏好驱动的优化,否则一般有条件或可控制的生成不单是因为它采用了文字、位置或结构条件。 侧重于人类-AI互动、用户经验、意图表达或评价而不直接优化传播模式的研究被保留为背景参考,而不是列入核心内容。 同样,提出奖励模式、评价衡量标准或基准而未优化推广模式的工作也被用作分析以人为本的评价做法的补充证据。

blocks.en: 3.2. Data Extraction and Thematic Analysis
blocks.zh: 3.2. 数据提取和专题分析

blocks.en: For each included study, we extracted information related to human intent, including intent source, expression form, proxy construction, user involvement, and the stage at which human preferences influenced optimization. We also recorded technical characteristics, including publication year, generation task, base model, optimization objectives, intervention mechanisms, and evaluation methods. These variables allowed us to examine both how human needs were operationalized and how the resulting objectives shaped diffusion model optimization.
blocks.zh: 对于每个研究,我们提取了与人类意图有关的信息,包括意图来源,表达形式,代理构建,用户参与,以及人类偏好影响优化的阶段. 我们还记录了技术特点,包括出版年份、生成任务、基准模型、优化目标、干预机制和评价方法。 这些变量使我们能够审查人类需求如何运作,以及由此产生的目标如何形成传播模式优化。

blocks.en: The coding framework was organized around the four research questions. For RQ1, we examined how human intent was expressed, represented, and translated into rewards, preference signals, or other computational proxies. For RQ2, we analyzed how these objectives influenced model behavior or generation trajectories, distinguishing model-level and generation-level optimization . For RQ3, we recorded proxy-objective mismatches, competing objectives, diversity-related trade-offs, optimization costs, and reported failure modes. For RQ4, we extracted automated metrics, human judgments, expert evaluations, and contextual validation methods, with particular attention to whether evaluation practices reflected individual preferences and actual user needs.
blocks.zh: 编码框架是围绕四个研究问题编排的。 对于RQ1,我们研究了人类意图是如何表达,表达的,并转化为奖励,偏好信号,或其他计算代词. 对于RQ2,我们分析了这些目标如何影响模型行为或生成轨迹,区分模型级别和生成级别优化. 就RQ3而言,我们记录了代理目标不匹配、相互竞争的目标、与多样性有关的权衡、优化成本和报告失败模式。 就RQ4而言,我们提取了自动衡量标准、人力判断、专家评价和背景验证方法,特别注意评价做法是否反映个人偏好和实际用户需要。

blocks.en: We then conducted iterative thematic analysis to identify recurring patterns and differences across studies. Rather than organizing the literature solely by algorithm type, we compared studies according to how human intent was represented, how optimization objectives were applied, what tensions emerged, and how alignment outcomes were evaluated. Related codes were grouped into broader themes, while distinctions in intent sources, proxy construction, and optimization intervention points were preserved. Ambiguous cases were revisited to refine the coding categories and maintain consistent interpretation across the research corpus.
blocks.zh: 然后,我们进行了迭代专题分析,以查明各种研究的反复出现模式和差异。 我们不是只按照算法类型来整理文献,而是根据人们的意图是如何表达的、如何应用优化目标、出现何种紧张关系以及如何评价调整结果来比较研究。 相关代码被归类为更广泛的主题,同时保留了意图来源、代理构建和优化干预点方面的区别。 重审了含糊不清的案件,以完善编码类别,并保持整个研究文书的一致解释。

blocks.en: 3.3. Final Corpus and Analytical Scope
blocks.zh: 3.3. 最后公司和分析范围

blocks.en: The final research corpus covered two main pathways through which human-centered objectives influence diffusion model optimization. Model-level optimization updates model parameters to incorporate human preferences into generation behavior, enabling relatively persistent adaptation across subsequent generations. In contrast, generation-level optimization keeps the base model fixed and adjusts the current generation process through guidance, latent optimization, or trajectory intervention. These pathways differ not only in their optimization mechanisms but also in how human intent influences generation behavior and when users can intervene. Since some studies involved multiple mechanisms, we categorized them according to their primary intervention points and the ways in which optimization objectives were applied, without treating the two pathways as mutually exclusive.
blocks.zh: 最终研究包涵盖以人为中心的目标影响传播模式优化的两个主要途径。 模型级优化更新模型参数,将人类偏好融入到生成行为中,使得后世之间能够相对持续的适应. 相比之下,生成级优化通过引导,潜伏优化,或轨迹干预,保持基模型固定,调整当前生成过程. 这些途径不仅在优化机制方面,而且在人类意图如何影响生成行为以及用户何时可以干预方面,都有所不同. 由于一些研究涉及多种机制,我们根据它们的主要干预点以及应用优化目标的方式对它们进行分类,而没有将两种途径视为相互排斥。

blocks.en: Rather than organizing the corpus solely by algorithm type, we structured the analysis around the four research questions. Specifically, we first examine how human intent is expressed, represented, and operationalized into computational objectives (RQ1). We then analyze how these objectives influence model behavior or generation trajectories through different optimization mechanisms (RQ2). Next, we investigate the trade-offs, tensions, and failure modes that may emerge when optimizing toward human-defined or human-proxied objectives (RQ3). Finally, we examine how automated and human-centered evaluation practices validate whether optimization outcomes genuinely align with human preferences and user needs (RQ4). Together, these dimensions provide a unified analytical scope for understanding how human intent is represented, executed, potentially distorted, and evaluated throughout diffusion model optimization. To provide an overview of the analytical structure developed in the following sections, Tab . 1 summarizes the proposed taxonomy tables across Sections 4–9. It outlines the main classification dimensions covered in each section, ranging from the stakeholders shaping optimization goals and the operationalization of human intent to optimization methods, associated trade-offs, evaluation practices, and future research directions. This overview provides a roadmap for the subsequent systematic analysis.
blocks.zh: 我们不是仅仅按照算法类型来组织调查, 而是围绕四个研究问题来分析。 具体地说,我们首先审查人类意图是如何表达、体现和转化为计算目标的(RQ1)。 然后我们通过不同的优化机制(RQ2)分析这些目标如何影响模型行为或生成轨迹. 其次,我们调查在优化实现人为或人为目标时可能出现的权衡、紧张和失败模式(RQ3)。 最后,我们审查自动化和以人为本的评价做法如何验证优化结果是否真正符合人类喜好和用户需求(RQ4)。 这些层面共同提供了一个统一的分析范围,用以了解在整个传播模型优化过程中人类意图是如何体现、执行、潜在扭曲和评价的。 为了概述以下各节中发展的分析结构,Tab. 1概述了第4至第9节的拟议分类表。 报告概述了各节涵盖的主要分类层面,从确定优化目标和将人类意图付诸实施的利益攸关方到优化方法、相关权衡、评价做法和未来的研究方向。 这一概述为随后的系统分析提供了路线图。

blocks.en: 4. The Landscape of Human-Centered Diffusion Model Optimization
blocks.zh: 4个 以人为中心的传播模式优化的景观

blocks.en: Figure 5. A human-centered taxonomy of human intent in diffusion model optimization, organized along three dimensions: (1) What: the goals that human-centered optimization seeks to satisfy, including output quality, task fidelity, individual preferences, and process control; (2) Who: the stakeholders who define or mediate optimization goals, including end users, researchers, domain experts, and computational proxies; and (3) Where: the entry points through which human intent influences optimization, including objective construction, model adaptation, inference-time intervention, and iterative feedback. Together, these dimensions characterize how human intent is expressed, shaped, operationalized, and continuously refined throughout diffusion model optimization.
blocks.zh: 图5. 传播模型优化中以人为本的人类意图分类法,分三个方面: (1) 以人为中心的优化力求达到的目标,包括产出质量、任务忠实、个人偏好和过程控制;(2) 谁:界定或调解优化目标的利害关系方,包括最终用户、研究人员、域专家和计算代理人;(3) 何方:人类意图影响优化的切入点,包括客观构建、模型调整、推论时间干预和迭代反馈。 这些层面共同构成了人类意图如何在传播模式优化过程中表达、塑造、操作和不断完善的特点。

blocks.en: This section characterizes the research landscape of human-centered diffusion model optimization through three interconnected dimensions derived from our thematic analysis. First, we examine the diverse human goals that existing optimization methods seek to satisfy, including generation quality, task fidelity, and individual preferences. Second, we analyze who defines and shapes these optimization goals, considering the roles of users, researchers, domain experts, and computational proxies. Third, we investigate how and at which stages human intent enters the optimization process through different interaction signals. Together, these dimensions provide a human-centered understanding of the research landscape and establish the foundation for the next section, which further examines how human intent is represented and translated into machine-optimizable objectives. Fig . 5 summarizes these three dimensions, providing an integrated taxonomy of human goals, the stakeholders shaping optimization objectives, and the entry points through which human intent influences the optimization process.
blocks.zh: 本节通过我们的专题分析得出的三个相互关联的层面,描述以人类为中心的传播模型优化的研究格局。 首先,我们审查现有优化方法所追求的各种人类目标,包括生成质量、任务忠诚和个人偏好。 第二,我们分析谁定义和塑造这些优化目标,考虑用户、研究人员、域专家以及计算代理的作用。 第三,我们调查人类意图如何和在哪个阶段通过不同的相互作用信号进入优化过程。 这些层面共同提供了对研究景观的以人为本的理解,并为下一节奠定了基础,该节进一步审视了人类意图如何得到体现并转化为机器上理想的目标。 数字。 5 总结了这三个层面,提供了人类目标的综合分类,利益攸关方塑造优化目标,以及人类意图影响优化进程的切入点。

blocks.en: 4.1. What Human Goals Are Targeted in Diffusion Optimization?
blocks.zh: 4.1. 在传播优化方面有哪些发展目标?

blocks.en: Existing studies often describe their goals as ‘better meeting human needs’, but these needs encompass different dimensions of human intent. Some methods primarily focus on the quality of generated outputs, such as aesthetic appeal, visual realism, or perceptual quality. Others emphasize how faithfully the model responds to user requests, including text-image alignment and the accurate depiction of objects, attributes, and relations. Thus, even when described as alignment, different methods may prioritize aesthetic preferences or task fidelity ( Huang et al., 2025b ; Li et al., 2024b ) .
blocks.zh: 现有研究往往将其目标描述为 " 更好地满足人类需求 " ,但这些需求包含人类意图的不同层面。 一些方法主要侧重于生成产出的质量,如审美吸引力,视觉现实主义,或感知质量. 其他人则强调模型如何忠实地响应用户的要求,包括文本图像对齐和准确描绘对象,属性,关系. 因此,即使被描述为调和,不同的方法也可能优先考虑审美偏好或任务忠贞(Huang等人,2025年b;Li等人,2024年b)。

blocks.en: With the development of personalized generation, optimization goals have increasingly expanded beyond group-level preferences to account for individual differences. The central question is therefore not only ‘what kind of image is generally better’, but also ‘what kind of result better satisfies the needs of a particular user’. Some studies incorporate personal choices, historical feedback, or repeated interactions to adapt generation behavior to individual preferences ( Li et al., 2025c ; Zhao et al., 2025 ; Xu et al., 2024 ; Xiao et al., 2025 ; Peng et al., 2024 ) .
blocks.zh: 随着个性化生成的发展,优化目标日益扩大,超越了集团层面的偏好,以计入个人差异. 因此,中心问题不仅在于 " 何种形象一般更好 " ,而且在于 " 何种结果能更好地满足特定用户的需要 " 。 一些研究包括个人选择,历史反馈,或反复互动,使生成行为适应个人偏好(李等人,2025c;赵等人,2025;徐等人,2024;萧等人,2025;彭等人,2024).

blocks.en: Human needs extend beyond the quality of the final image. In interactive creation and editing, users may value structure preservation, local controllability, output diversity, and opportunities for creative exploration. These aspects influence not only what users expect from generated results but also how they wish to interact with and control the generation process. As summarized in Tab . 4 , human intent in diffusion model optimization encompasses four categories: output quality, task fidelity, individual preferences, and process-level control. These categories are not mutually exclusive; they may coexist within a task and evolve in relative importance as users interact with the system.
blocks.zh: 人类的需求超出了最终形象的质量。 在互动创建和编辑中,用户可能重视结构保存,局部可控性,输出多样性,以及创造性探索的机会. 这些方面不仅影响用户对所产生结果的期望,而且影响他们希望如何与生成过程互动和控制生成过程。 如Tab摘要所示。 4,人类在传播模型优化中的用意包括四类:产出质量,任务忠心,个人偏好,以及过程级控制. 这些类别并非相互排斥;它们可能在一项任务中共存,随着用户与系统的互动而相对重要。

blocks.en: 4.2. Who Shapes the Optimization Goal?
blocks.zh: 4.2. 谁塑造了优化目标?

blocks.en: Table 4. Taxonomy of human goals targeted in diffusion model optimization. These categories are analytically distinguishable but often co-exist within a single generation or editing task.
blocks.zh: 图表 4. 在传播模式优化中针对人类目标的分类。 这些类别在分析上可以区分,但往往在单一一代或编辑任务中共存。

blocks.en: Optimization goals in diffusion models are not always directly defined by end users. In user-driven settings, individuals express their needs through text, ratings, rankings, or preference comparisons, allowing their judgments to influence the optimization direction. However, the extent of this influence depends on how these signals are interpreted and incorporated into the optimization process.
blocks.zh: 传播模型中的优化目标并不总是由终端用户直接定义. 在用户驱动的设置中,个人通过文字,评分,排名或偏好比较来表达自己的需要,让自己的判断影响优化方向. 然而,这种影响的程度取决于如何解释这些信号并将其纳入优化进程。

blocks.en: In many studies, researchers determine which attributes should be optimized, such as aesthetic quality, text-image alignment, or task-specific performance. Human feedback is then collected or interpreted within these predefined dimensions. Consequently, even when optimization relies on human evaluations, the underlying definition of what constitutes a better result may still be largely determined by the research design. Similarly, in professional domains such as medicine or design, domain experts and established professional standards may influence the definition of desirable outputs. In these settings, optimization goals can reflect both individual user needs and domain-specific requirements.
blocks.zh: 在许多研究中,研究人员决定应该优化哪些属性,如美学质量,文本图像对齐,或任务特定性能. 然后在这些预先界定的维度内收集或解释人类的反馈。 因此,即使优化依赖于人类评价,对什么是更好结果的基本定义仍可能在很大程度上由研究设计决定。 同样,在医学或设计等专业领域,领域专家和既定专业标准可能影响对理想产出的定义。 在这些环境下,优化目标既可以反映个人用户的需求,也可以反映特定领域的需求.

blocks.en: Computational proxies introduce a layer of mediation between human judgments and optimization objectives. Reward models, preference models, and VLM-based evaluators can transform human evaluations or predefined criteria into automatic optimization signals. However, these proxies may preserve certain aspects of human preferences while overlooking others, thereby influencing which objectives are reinforced during optimization ( Huang et al., 2025c ) . Thus, optimization goals may be shaped through the combined influence of users, researchers, domain experts, and computational proxies, although their roles in defining and mediating these goals differ. Distinguishing these roles is essential for understanding whose preferences are represented and how faithfully the objectives reflect the intentions of specific users.
blocks.zh: 计算代理引入了人类判断与优化目标之间的层次调解. 奖励模型,偏好模型,以及基于VLM的评价师可以将人类评价或预先确定的标准转化为自动优化信号. 然而,这些代理人可能保留人类偏好的某些方面,而忽略其他方面,从而影响哪些目标在优化期间得到加强(Huang等人,2025c)。 因此,优化目标可以通过用户、研究人员、域专家以及计算代理人的综合影响来形成,尽管它们在界定和调解这些目标方面的作用不同。 区分这些作用对于了解谁的偏好和这些目标如何忠实地反映具体用户的意图至关重要。

blocks.en: 4.3. Where Does Human Intent Enter the Optimization Process?
blocks.zh: 4.3. 人类的本意在哪里进入优化进程?

blocks.en: Human intent can be expressed through various interaction signals, including text prompts, ratings, rankings, pairwise preferences, region selection, reference images, multi-turn edits, interaction history, and expert judgments in professional settings. These signals differ in their information granularity, user effort, and ability to communicate specific preferences or constraints. However, not every interaction signal directly participates in optimization. Within the scope of this review, such signals become relevant to diffusion model optimization when they are used to construct objectives, guide model adaptation, or actively intervene in the generation process.
blocks.zh: 人类的意图可以通过各种互动信号表达,包括文本提示,评级,排名,对偶偏好,区域选择,参考图像,多回合编辑,互动历史,以及专业环境下的专家判断. 这些信号在信息颗粒性,用户努力程度,以及沟通具体偏好或制约因素的能力方面各不相同. 然而,并不是每个互动信号都直接参与优化. 在本次审查的范围内,当这些信号用于构建目标、指导模型的适应或积极干预生成过程时,它们就与传播模型优化有关。

blocks.en: Human intent can influence optimization at different stages rather than entering the system only through an initial request. Some studies incorporate human preferences during feedback collection and objective construction, translating user judgments into rewards, preference models, or other computational proxies. Others introduce these objectives during training or fine-tuning to influence subsequent generation behavior. Alternatively, human-defined or human-proxied objectives can guide the current generation process at inference time through latent adjustments, guidance mechanisms, or trajectory interventions ( Ding et al., 2025 ; Aiello et al., 2025 ; Huang et al., 2025d ) . After generation, users may further provide choices, ratings, or editing instructions that inform subsequent rounds of interaction and optimization. Fig . 6 provides an overview of the interaction signals through which human intent is expressed and illustrates how these signals influence different stages of the diffusion model optimization process, from objective construction and model adaptation to inference-time intervention and iterative user feedback.
blocks.zh: 人类的意图可以在不同阶段影响优化,而不是仅仅通过初始请求进入系统. 一些研究在反馈收集和客观构建过程中将人类偏好纳入,将用户判断转化为奖励,偏好模型,或其他计算代词. 另一些则在训练或微调时引入这些目标,以影响后一代的行为. 或者,由人类确定的目标或由人类提出的目标可以通过潜在的调整、指导机制或轨迹干预在推论时指导目前的生成过程(Ding等人,2025年;Aiello等人,2025年;Huang等人,2025年d )。 生成后,用户可能会进一步提供选择,评分,或编辑指令,为后续几轮互动和优化提供信息. 图6概述了表达人类意图的相互作用信号,并说明了这些信号如何影响传播模型优化过程的不同阶段,从客观构造和模型调整到推断时间干预和迭代用户反馈.

blocks.en: Therefore, human intent should not be understood as a fixed condition supplied only at the system input. Instead, it may enter and influence diffusion model optimization through objective construction, model adaptation, inference-time intervention, and iterative user feedback. Identifying these entry points helps clarify when users can influence generation behavior and provides a basis for examining how their expressed intentions are subsequently transformed into machine-optimizable objectives.
blocks.zh: 因此,不应将人类意图理解为仅由系统输入提供的固定条件。 相反,它可能通过客观构建、模型调整、推断时间干预和迭代用户反馈进入并影响传播模型优化。 确定这些切入点有助于澄清用户何时可以影响生成行为,并为审查其表达的意图随后如何转化为机器优化的目标提供依据.

blocks.en: Figure 6. Human intent and its entry points in diffusion model optimization. Human needs are expressed through diverse interaction signals and can influence objective construction, model adaptation, inference-time intervention, and iterative feedback. These entry points are not mutually exclusive and may jointly support evolving user preferences across generation and editing tasks.
blocks.zh: 图 6. 人类意图及其传播模式优化的切入点。 人类需求通过不同的交互信号表达,并可以影响客观构造,模型适应,推论时间干预和迭代反馈. 这些切入点并非相互排斥,可能共同支持用户在生成和编辑任务上不断发展的偏好.

blocks.en: 5. From Human Intent to Optimization Objectives
blocks.zh: 5.五. 从人类意图到优化目标

blocks.en: Sec. 4 has characterized what human goals existing studies seek to satisfy, who shapes these goals, and where human intent enters diffusion model optimization. Building on this analysis, this section examines how expressed human needs are represented and operationalized into computational objectives, thereby addressing RQ1. Specifically, we trace the transformation from intent representation and proxy construction to objective coordination and potential proxy mismatches, examining how human intent becomes machine-optimizable and where information may be lost or distorted. Tab . 5 summarizes the main categories of human intent representation and operationalization identified in our review. Specifically, we distinguish intent representation, proxy objective construction, objective coordination, and proxy mismatch, highlighting how human needs are progressively transformed into machine-optimizable objectives and where discrepancies may arise. This classification provides an analytical overview of RQ1 and establishes the foundation for the following discussion.
blocks.zh: 第4节说明了现有研究所追求的人类目标、如何塑造这些目标以及人类意图进入传播模式优化的特征。 在这一分析的基础上,本节审查如何将表达的人类需求体现在计算目标中并付诸实施,从而解决RQ1问题。 具体地说,我们追踪从意图表述和代理结构到客观协调和潜在代理错配的转变,审查人类意图如何成为机器最佳,以及信息可能丢失或扭曲的地方。 标签5总结了我们审查中确定的人类意图表现和操作的主要类别。 具体地说,我们区分了意向表述、代理客观构建、客观协调以及代理不匹配,突出了人类需求如何逐渐转化为机器优化目标,以及可能出现的差异。 这一分类为RQ1提供了分析概览,并为以下讨论奠定了基础.

blocks.en: 5.1. From Expressed Intent to Machine-Readable Representations
blocks.zh: 5.1. 从意向表示到机器可读表示

blocks.en: Human needs, particularly those that are subjective or context-dependent, cannot always be directly used as computational optimization objectives. Once expressed through interaction signals, human intent must be formalized into attributes, constraints, or preferences that can be represented, compared, and computed. For example, ‘better matching my taste’ may be represented through aesthetic quality, visual realism, or style preferences, while ‘better following my request’ may be expressed through semantic consistency, object attributes, or structural constraints ( Xing et al., 2024 ) .
blocks.zh: 人类的需要,特别是主观或环境依赖的需要,不能总是直接用作计算优化的目标。 一旦通过互动信号表达出来,人类的意图就必须正式化为属性、限制或偏好,这些属性、限制或偏好可以反映、比较和计算。 例如,`更好地匹配我的品味 ' 可能通过美学质量、视觉现实主义或风格偏好来表示,而`更符合我的要求 ' 则可以通过语义一致性、对象属性或结构约束来表示(Xing等人,2024年)。

blocks.en: This formalization determines what information subsequent optimization mechanisms can access. Explicit requirements can often be preserved as conditions or target attributes, whereas subjective preferences may require ratings, rankings, or pairwise comparisons to become computationally interpretable. More complex needs may also be represented through multimodal inputs, interaction history, or personalized user models ( Lu et al., 2025 ; Dang et al., 2025 ; Li et al., 2026a ) .
blocks.zh: 这种形式化决定了后续优化机制能够访问的信息. 明确的要求往往可以作为条件或目标属性加以保留,而主观偏好则可能需要评级,排名,或双向比较才能在计算上解释. 更为复杂的需求也可通过多式联运投入、互动历史或个性化用户模式得到体现(Lu等人,2025年;Dang等人,2025年;Li等人,2026a年)。

blocks.en: Therefore, intent representation is not simply the preservation of user input, but a selective transformation of human needs into machine-readable information. While this process enables computational optimization, it also determines which aspects of the original intent are retained and which may be omitted before subsequent optimization begins.
blocks.zh: 因此,意图表示不仅仅是保存用户输入,而是有选择地将人类需求转化为机器可读信息. 虽然这个过程能够实现计算优化,但它也决定了原意的哪些方面被保留下来,哪些方面可能在随后的优化开始前被省略.

blocks.en: Table 5. Taxonomy of Human Intent Representation and Operationalization. Existing studies and analytical concepts are organized according to how human needs are represented, transformed into computational objectives, coordinated, and potentially misaligned during optimization.
blocks.zh: 图表 5. 人类意图代表和运作分类。 现有研究和分析概念是按照人类需求如何得到反映、如何转化为计算目标、如何协调以及在优化过程中可能错配而成的。

blocks.en: 5.2. From Human Signals to Proxy Objectives
blocks.zh: 5.2. 从人类信号到代理目标

blocks.en: Machine-readable representations of human intent do not necessarily constitute objectives that optimization algorithms can directly optimize. Whether these representations originate from textual instructions, preference judgments, or other interaction signals, they often need to be translated into computational objectives that can evaluate generated results and provide optimization signals. This translation forms a critical connection between human intent expression and diffusion model optimization.
blocks.zh: 机器可读的对人类意图的表示并不一定构成优化算法可以直接优化的目标. 无论这些表述来源于文字指示,偏好判断,还是其他互动信号,它们往往需要被转化为可以评价生成的结果并提供优化信号的计算目标. 这种翻译在人类意图表达与传播模型优化之间形成了关键的联系.

blocks.en: One common approach constructs reward or preference models from human evaluations, allowing discrete judgments to be approximated by reusable functions ( Lee et al., 2025 ; Yuan et al., 2024 ; Ye et al., 2025 ; Wang et al., 2025a ; Huang et al., 2025a ; Luo et al., 2025 ; Liang et al., 2024 ; Xing et al., 2025b ; Croitoru et al., 2025 ; Li et al., 2025b ; Wang et al., 2025c ) . Approaches employ predefined aesthetic metrics, vision-language models, or task-specific evaluators to approximate selected aspects of human needs as scores. Although these objectives differ in their sources and construction methods, they serve a similar function in optimization: providing measurable signals that guide model updates or generation-time interventions.
blocks.zh: 一种共同办法构建了人类评价的奖励或偏好模式,允许用可重复使用的功能来大致作出独立的判断(Lee等人,2025年;Yean等人,2024年;Ye等人,2025年;Wang等人,2025年a); Huang等人,2025a;Luo等人,2025;Liang等人,2024;Xing等人,2025b;Croitoru等人,2025;Li等人,2025b;Wang等人,2025c) 方法使用预定义的美学度量衡,视觉语言模型,或针对特定任务的评价人员,将人类需求的某些方面作为分数来进行估计. 虽然这些目标的来源和构建方法不同,但它们在优化方面起到类似的作用:提供可计量的信号,指导模型更新或生成时间干预.

blocks.en: This operationalization improves the computability and scalability of human-centered objectives, but it also introduces an additional layer between human intent and algorithmic optimization. Rather than directly optimizing the original human need, algorithms operate on proxy objectives derived from human judgments, learned representations, or predefined evaluation criteria ( Yang et al., 2026 ) . Consequently, proxy construction determines not only which objectives can be optimized, but also which aspects of human intent are emphasized or overlooked during subsequent generation.
blocks.zh: 这种可操作性提高了以人为中心的目标的可计算性和可扩展性,但也引入了人类意图和算法优化之间的额外一层. 算法不是直接优化原始人类需求,而是运行在从人类判断,学到的表述,或预先设定的评价标准(杨等人,2026年)中衍生出来的代理目标上. 因此,代理构建不仅决定了哪些目标可以优化,而且还决定了人类意图的哪些方面在下一代受到强调或忽视。

blocks.en: 5.3. Multi-Objective Trade-offs and Evolving Intent
blocks.zh: 5.3. 多目标权衡和不断演变的意向

blocks.en: After human needs are translated into computational objectives, a further challenge arises from the relationships among these objectives. Personalized generation often involves multiple dimensions, including aesthetic quality, semantic consistency, realism, diversity, and structure preservation. However, these objectives cannot always be improved simultaneously. For example, stronger semantic constraints may restrict the available exploration space, while emphasizing aesthetic rewards may favor a narrower range of high-scoring outputs ( Xie and Gong, 2025 ; Yan et al., 2026c ; Yan et al., ) . Optimization systems often employ weighting, ranking, or other aggregation strategies to coordinate competing objectives.
blocks.zh: 在人类需求转化为计算目标后,这些目标之间的关系又产生了另一个挑战。 个性化一代往往涉及多个维度,包括美学质量,语义一致性,现实主义,多样性,以及结构保存. 然而,这些目标并非总是同时得到改进。 例如,较强的语义限制可能限制现有的探索空间,同时强调审美奖励可能有利于范围较窄的高分产出(谢和龚,2025年;Yan等人,2026年c; 颜等, ). 优化系统往往采用加权、排名或其他汇总战略来协调相互竞争的目标。

blocks.en: A central difficulty is that objective relationships are frequently established through relatively static weights or predefined priorities, whereas human preferences may evolve across tasks and interactions. For instance, users may initially prioritize semantic fidelity but later place greater importance on diversity after observing several generated candidates. Similarly, during image editing, structure preservation may become increasingly important as an output approaches the desired result. Such changes mean that a fixed combination of objectives may no longer accurately reflect the user’s current priorities.
blocks.zh: 一个核心困难是,客观关系往往通过相对静态的权重或预先确定的优先事项来建立,而人类的偏好则可能在任务和互动之间演变。 例如,用户最初可能优先考虑语义忠诚,但后来在观察了几个产生的候选人之后,更加重视多样性。 同样,在图像编辑过程中,随着产出接近预期结果,结构保存可能变得越来越重要。 这种变化意味着,固定的目标组合可能不再准确地反映用户目前的优先事项。

blocks.en: Therefore, multi-objective coordination is not merely a technical problem of optimizing several metrics simultaneously. It also concerns whether the relationships among computational objectives remain consistent with the user’s evolving intent. The way objectives are combined effectively determines what the optimization system considers a better result. When these relationships fail to adapt to changing human preferences, the constructed optimization objective may gradually diverge from what the user actually seeks to achieve.
blocks.zh: 因此,多目标协调不仅仅是同时优化若干衡量标准的技术问题。 它还涉及计算目标之间的关系是否与用户不断变化的意图相一致。 目标结合的方式有效地决定了优化系统认为更好的结果是什么. 当这些关系无法适应不断变化的人类偏好时,构建的优化目标可能会逐渐偏离用户实际寻求实现的目标.

blocks.en: 5.4. The Human–Proxy Gap
blocks.zh: 5.4. 人与人之间的差距

blocks.en: Based on the preceding analysis, we characterize the potential structural mismatch between human intent and the computational objectives used by optimization algorithms as the Human–Proxy Gap . Before human needs can guide optimization, they undergo several transformations, including intent expression, machine-readable representation, proxy construction, and objective coordination. Each transformation may preserve certain aspects of human intent while omitting contextual information, individual differences, or relationships among objectives ( Liu et al., 2025a ) . Consequently, the resulting proxy objectives may represent only part of what users actually want.
blocks.zh: 基于上述分析,我们把人类意图与优化算法所用的计算目标之间的潜在结构不匹配定性为人类-Proxy差距。 在人类需求能够引导优化之前,它们会经历几个转变,包括意图表达,机器可读表达,代理构建,以及客观协调. 每个转变都可能保留人类意图的某些方面,同时省略背景信息、个人差异或目标之间的关系(Liu等人,2025a)。 因此,由此产生的代用目标可能只是用户实际想要的。

blocks.en: Importantly, the Human–Proxy Gap is not equivalent to reward prediction error ( Karthik et al., 2025 ) . Even when a reward model accurately predicts its predefined evaluation target, the optimization system may still produce unsatisfactory results if that target does not fully capture the user’s needs, if competing objectives are combined inappropriately, or if preferences change over time. In such cases, the proxy objective may be accurately estimated and successfully optimized while remaining misaligned with the user’s current intent ( Yang et al., 2024b ) .
blocks.zh: 重要的是,人类-Proxy差距并不等于奖励性预测错误(Karthik等人,2025年)。 即使奖励模式准确预测其预先确定的评价目标,如果该目标不能完全抓住用户的需求,如果相互竞争的目标合并不当,或者如果偏好随时间而变化,优化系统仍可能产生不令人满意的结果. 在这种情况下,可以准确估计并成功优化代理目标,同时保持与用户当前意图的错位(Yang等人,2024b.).

blocks.en: From this perspective, addressing RQ1 requires more than identifying which rewards or preference signals are used in existing methods. It requires understanding how human needs are progressively transformed into computational objectives and where discrepancies may emerge during this process. The Human–Proxy Gap therefore provides a foundation for the analysis of optimization mechanisms. The next section examines how model-level and generation-level optimization execute these constructed objectives to influence model behavior or generation trajectories.
blocks.zh: 从这个角度出发,处理RQ1需要的不仅仅是确定现有方法中使用哪些奖励或偏好信号。 它要求了解人类需求如何逐渐转化为计算目标,以及在这一过程中可能出现差异的地方。 因此,人与物之间差距为分析优化机制提供了基础。 下一节考察模型级和生成级优化如何执行这些构建的目标来影响模型行为或生成轨迹.

blocks.en: 6. Optimizing Diffusion Models Toward Human Intent
blocks.zh: 6. 优化传播模式以达到人类的意向

blocks.en: This section addresses RQ2 introduced in Sec. 1 . Sec. 5 has examined how human needs are represented and transformed into machine-optimizable proxy objectives. Building on this analysis, we investigate how these objectives are applied to diffusion models and translated into changes in generation behavior. Existing methods can be broadly organized into two pathways: model-level optimization , which updates model parameters to influence subsequent generations, and generation-level optimization , which keeps the base model fixed while intervening in the current generation process. Beyond comparing their technical mechanisms, we examine how these pathways differ in the persistence of preference adaptation and the opportunities they provide for user intervention, thereby connecting diffusion model optimization with human agency. Tab . 6 summarizes the main categories of human-centered diffusion model optimization methods, distinguishing model-level and generation-level approaches according to their optimization mechanisms and intervention points.To provide a consolidated view of the two analytical dimensions, Fig . 7 presents complementary taxonomies developed in Sections 5 and 6. The left panel organizes human intent operationalization into four dimensions: intent representation, proxy objective construction, objective coordination, and proxy mismatch. It further identifies representative mechanisms within each dimension, including explicit requirements, personalized representations, reward modeling, computational evaluators, and multi-objective aggregation. The right panel categorizes human-centered diffusion optimization methods into two primary paradigms: model-level optimization, which includes reinforcement learning fine-tuning and preference-based optimization, and generation-level optimization, which encompasses training-free guidance and latent or trajectory optimization. Together, these taxonomies connect the construction of machine-optimizable objectives with their subsequent execution in diffusion models, providing a unified view of how human intent is translated into and acted upon by optimization mechanisms.
blocks.zh: 本节论述第1节提出的RQ2。 第5条审查了人类需求如何得到体现,如何转化为机器上最理想的代用目标。 基于这一分析,我们调查这些目标如何应用于传播模型,并转化为生成行为的变化. 现有方法可以大致分为两种途径:模型级优化(Model-level estification ),即更新模型参数以影响后世;生成级优化(the generation-level estification),即保持基模型固定,同时介入当前生成过程. 除了比较它们的技术机制外,我们研究这些途径在持续调整优惠和它们为用户干预提供的机会方面有何不同,从而将传播模式优化与人类机构联系起来。 Tab 6总结了以人为中心的传播模型优化方法的主要类别,根据其优化机制和干预点区分模型层次和生成层次的方法. 为了综合说明这两个分析层面,图7介绍了第5和第6节中拟订的补充分类。 左面面面面面面面面面面面面面面面面面面面面面面面面面面面面面面面面面面面面面面面面面面面面面面面面面面面面面面面面面面面面面面面面面面面面面面面面面面面面面面面面面面面面面面面面面面面面面面面面面面面面面面面面面面面面面面面面面面面面面面面面面面面面面面面面面面面面面面面面面面面面面面面面面面面面面面面面面面面面面面面面面面面面面面面面面面面面面面面面面面面面面面面面面面面面面面面面面面面面面面面面面面面面面面面面面面面面面面面面面面面面面面面面面面面面面面面面面面面面面面面面面面面面面面面面面面面面面面 它进一步确定了每个层面中的代表性机制,包括明确要求、个性化表述、奖励建模、计算评价员和多目标汇总。 右面板将以人为本的传播优化方法分类为两个主要范式:模型级优化,包括强化学习微调和基于偏好优化,以及生成级优化,包括无培训指导和潜伏或轨迹优化. 这些分类法共同将机器优化目标的构建与随后在扩散模型中的执行联系起来,为人类意图如何转化为并通过优化机制采取行动提供了统一的观点.

blocks.en: 6.1. Model-Level: Persistent Intent Adaptation
blocks.zh: 6.1. 模式层面:长期性适应

blocks.en: Model-level optimization updates model parameters according to constructed proxy objectives, allowing human preferences to influence subsequent generation behavior beyond a single inference process. Representative approaches include reinforcement learning fine-tuning and preference-based optimization. Although these approaches differ in how preference information is represented and incorporated into training, both aim to adjust the model’s generation distribution toward outputs favored by their respective objectives.
blocks.zh: 模型级优化根据构建的代理目标更新模型参数,允许人类偏好在单一推论过程之外影响后续生成行为. 具有代表性的方法包括加强学习的微调和基于优惠的优化。 虽然这些办法在如何反映并纳入培训中方面有所不同,但这两种办法都旨在调整模式的生成分布,使之适应各自目标所偏爱的产出。

blocks.en: Table 6. Taxonomy of Human-Centered Diffusion Model Optimization Methods. Existing approaches are categorized according to their primary intervention level and optimization mechanism.
blocks.zh: 图表 6. 以人为中心的传播模式优化方法分类。 现有办法根据其主要干预水平和优化机制分类。

blocks.en: Reinforcement learning fine-tuning typically evaluates generated outputs using reward signals and updates model parameters to increase the likelihood of high-reward outcomes or generation trajectories. Through this process, human-defined or human-proxied objectives are translated into parameter updates that reshape the model’s generation behavior ( Yan et al., 2025 ; Hu et al., 2025 ; Jia et al., 2025 ; Miao et al., 2024 ) . Preference-based optimization, in contrast, learns from relative judgments between preferred and less-preferred samples, allowing models to adapt their generation behavior without necessarily relying on an explicitly trained scalar reward model ( Liang et al., 2025 ; Wu et al., 2025 ; Na et al., 2025 ; Liu et al., 2025b ; Huang et al., 2026 ; Sun et al., 2025 ; Hong et al., 2026a ; An et al., 2025 ; Wang et al., 2026 ) . Despite their differences, both approaches translate preference-related supervision into changes in the likelihood of subsequent generated outputs.
blocks.zh: 加强学习微调一般使用奖励信号评价产生的产出,并更新模型参数,以增加高回报结果或生成轨迹的可能性. 通过这一过程,人类定义的目标或人类指向的目标被转化为参数更新,以重塑模型的生成行为(Yan等人,2025年;Hu等人,2025年;Jia等人,2025年;Miao等人,2024年)。 反之,基于优待的优化借鉴了优待和较不优待的样本之间的相对判断,让模型在不必然依赖经过明确培训的标尺奖励模式的情况下,调整其生成行为(梁等人,2025年;吴等人,2025年;纳等人,2025年;刘等人,2025年b;黄等人,2026年;孙等人,2025年;洪等人,2026年a;安等人,2025年;王等人,2026年). 尽管两种方法不同,但将与优惠有关的监督转化为随后产生产出的可能性的变化。

blocks.en: From a human-centered perspective, model-level optimization transforms preferences expressed during training into relatively persistent tendencies in model behavior. This can reduce the need to repeatedly specify the same preferences during subsequent generations. However, adaptation through parameter updates also introduces a distinction between preferences incorporated during training and those expressed by users in a particular interaction. While users may still influence outputs through prompts or other conditioning signals, changing previously learned tendencies may require additional adaptation or sufficiently effective inference-time control ( Shenaj et al., 2025 ; Guo et al., 2025c ; Cai et al., 2025 ; Cho et al., 2025 ; Ruiz et al., 2025 ; Soboleva et al., 2026 ; Peng et al., 2026 ) . Thus, model-level optimization emphasizes persistent preference adaptation, while the extent to which individual users can subsequently revise these preferences depends on the available interaction and control mechanisms.
blocks.zh: 从以人为本的角度看,模型层面优化将训练期间表达的偏好转化为模型行为中相对持久的倾向. 这可以减少在后世反复规定相同偏好的必要性. 然而,通过参数更新进行的适应,也对培训期间的偏好和用户在特定互动中表达的偏好作了区分。 虽然用户仍然可能通过提示信号或其他条件信号影响产出,但改变先前学到的趋势可能需要更多的适应或足够有效的推断时间控制(Shenaj等人,2025年;Guo等人,2025年c;Cai等人,2025年;Cho等人,2025年;Ruiz等人,2025年;Soboleva等人,2026年;Peng等人,2026年). 因此,模型层面的优化强调持续的偏好调整,而个别用户随后能够修改这些偏好的程度取决于现有的互动和控制机制.

blocks.en: 6.2. Generation-Level: Inference-Time Intent Execution
blocks.zh: 6.2. 代际:推断-时间故意执行

blocks.en: Generation-level optimization keeps the parameters of the base model fixed and applies human-defined or human-proxied objectives to influence the current generation process. Unlike model-level optimization, which modifies the model’s learned behavior across subsequent generations, generation-level approaches intervene in how a particular output is produced. This allows optimization objectives and constraints to be adapted to the requirements of individual generation tasks without retraining the base model.
blocks.zh: 世代级优化保持基模型的参数固定,并应用人类定义或人类指向的目标来影响目前的生成过程. 与改变模型在后世所学到的行为的模型级优化不同,代级方法介入特定产出的产生方式. 这使得优化目标和限制能够适应个体代代任务的要求,而无需再培训基模.

blocks.en: One group of methods introduces preference-related objectives into the denoising or sampling process through training-free guidance, modifying generation directions according to external signals ( Wallace et al., 2023 ; Park et al., 2025 ; Jeong et al., 2025 ; Kim et al., 2025a ) . Another group directly intervenes in latent representations or generation trajectories by updating intermediate states, exploring candidate trajectories, or selecting generation paths according to computational objectives ( Wei et al., 2026 ; Wu et al., 2026a ; Kim et al., 2025b ; Um and Ye, 2025 ; Bahng et al., 2025 ; Zhou et al., 2025 ; Simon et al., 2025 ; Jiang et al., 2025 ; Guo and Lin, 2024 ) . Although these approaches differ in their intervention mechanisms, they share the objective of steering the current generation process without permanently updating the base model parameters.
blocks.zh: 一组方法通过无培训指导,将与偏好有关的目标引入去名或取样过程,根据外部信号修改生成方向(Wallace等人,2023;Park等人,2025;Jeong等人,2025;Kim等人,2025a)。 另一组通过更新中间状态,探索候选轨迹,或根据计算目标选择生成路径,直接干预潜在表示或生成轨迹(Wei等人,2026年;Wu等人,2026年a; Kim等人,2025b;Um和Ye,2025;Bahng等人,2025;Zhou等人,2025;Simon等人,2025;Jiang等人,2025;Guo和Lin,2024。 ) 尽管这些方法在干预机制上有所不同,但它们都有一个目标,就是在不永久更新基准模型参数的情况下指导当前一代人的进程。

blocks.en: From the perspective of human intent, generation-level optimization provides a mechanism for adapting optimization objectives to the current task, prompt, or user. Depending on the method, objectives, guidance strengths, or local constraints may be adjusted between generation attempts or during the generation process. This flexibility can support task-specific personalization and iterative refinement. However, inference-time control does not necessarily imply direct user control, since optimization objectives may also be predefined by researchers or determined through computational proxies. Moreover, some methods introduce additional evaluation, gradient computation, or trajectory search during inference, creating different computational requirements and interaction costs ( Mo et al., 2024 ; Guo et al., 2025a ; Polaczek et al., 2025 ) . Therefore, generation-level optimization emphasizes immediate, task-specific intent execution, although the degree of user involvement and computational overhead varies across methods.
blocks.zh: 从人类意图的角度来看,生成级优化提供了一种机制,使优化目标适应当前的任务,即时,或用户. 根据方法,目标,引导优势,或局部约束,可以在生成尝试之间或在生成过程中进行调整. 这种灵活性可以支持针对具体任务的个性化和迭代完善. 然而,推断时间控制并不一定意味着直接的用户控制,因为优化目标也可能由研究者预先定义或通过计算代理确定. 此外,有些方法引入了额外的评价、梯度计算或推论期间的轨迹搜索,产生了不同的计算要求和相互作用成本(Mo等人,2024年;Guo等人,2025年a;Polaczek等人,2025年)。 因此,生成一级优化强调即时的、针对特定任务的意向执行,尽管用户的参与程度和计算间接费用因方法而异。

blocks.en: 6.3. Human Agency Across Optimization Paradigms
blocks.zh: 6.3. 整个优化范式的人类机构

blocks.en: The distinction between model-level and generation-level optimization concerns not only where optimization occurs, but also when and how users can influence the objectives that guide generation. Model-level optimization typically incorporates human preferences during feedback collection, reward construction, or preference-based training. These preferences can subsequently influence multiple generations without requiring repeated user input. However, the resulting model behavior may reflect aggregated or previously collected preferences rather than the evolving intentions of a particular user.
blocks.zh: 模型一级和生成一级优化之间的区别不仅涉及最优化发生的地方,而且涉及用户何时以及如何影响指导生成的目标。 模型级优化一般包含在反馈收集,奖励建设,或基于偏好的培训过程中的人类偏好. 这些偏好随后可以影响多代人,而不需要重复用户输入. 然而,由此产生的模型行为可能反映汇总或以前收集的偏好,而不是特定用户不断变化的意图.

blocks.en: Generation-level optimization, by contrast, provides opportunities to modify optimization objectives and constraints at inference time. This can allow generation behavior to respond more directly to changing task requirements or user preferences without additional model training. Nevertheless, such opportunities depend on whether the system exposes meaningful controls and allows users to revise the objectives used during optimization. When objectives are determined entirely by predefined evaluators, inference-time optimization may remain largely automated despite operating at the generation level.
blocks.zh: 相形之下,代级优化提供了在推论时间修改优化目标和制约的机会. 这可以让生成行为更直接地响应不断变化的任务要求或用户偏好,而无需额外的模型训练. 然而,这种机会取决于系统是否暴露了有意义的控制,并允许用户修改优化时使用的目标. 当目标完全由预先界定的评价人员确定时,尽管在生成一级运作,推论时间的优化可能在很大程度上仍然是自动化的。

blocks.en: Consequently, human agency cannot be inferred solely from whether model parameters are updated. A more meaningful distinction concerns when preferences are incorporated, who determines the optimization objectives, and to what extent users can inspect, revise, or override these objectives during interaction. Model-level optimization generally emphasizes persistent preference adaptation, whereas generation-level optimization offers greater potential for immediate objective adjustment. These differences provide a foundation for the next section, which examines how optimization mechanisms may introduce tensions between intent alignment, generative diversity, user control, and system costs.
blocks.zh: 因此,不能仅仅从模型参数是否更新来推断人的作用。 一个更有意义的区分问题涉及:在纳入优惠时,由谁决定优化目标,以及用户在互动期间可以在多大程度上检查、修订或推翻这些目标。 模型一级优化一般强调持续的偏好调整,而代级优化则为立即进行客观调整提供了更大的潜力。 这些差异为下一节奠定了基础,该节审查了优化机制如何在意图一致、基因多样性、用户控制和系统成本之间造成紧张关系。

blocks.zh: 7个 当优化失败用户时:紧张与权衡
